question: Of the corn straw fuel and the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel, which had the higher maximum weight loss rate at 30 °C/min, and what higher heating value does that fuel have?
expect: the corn straw fuel (SF), 27.62 %/min against 19.71; HHV 17.20 MJ/kg (Tables 4 and 1)
trap: the composite fuel's 21.96 MJ/kg, or oil sludge's 33.97
rendered:
According to the document, at a heating rate of 30 °C/min, the composite fuel (CF) had a maximum weight loss rate of 27.62%/min, while the corn straw fuel (SF) had a maximum weight loss rate of 43.01%/min. Therefore, SF had the higher maximum weight loss rate.

The document also states that the higher heating value of the composite fuel (CF) is 21.96 ± 0.10 MJ/kg.
